exportPage.description: Choose resources and formats to download the current data available to your account in one ZIP archive.
exportPage.airportScopeHint: Select one or more airports to limit airport-scoped resources. Leave the selection empty to include all current airports.
exportPage.airportScopeError: Airport selection could not be verified: {airports}. Retry before downloading.

exportPage.globalResources: Global resources remain complete when an airport scope is selected.

frame.hideNaipHint: On by default. Shows only tier 1–2 data across the whole console, leaving out NAIP. Applies to this browser only.

denied.title: No database access yet
denied.body: Access to the aeronautical database is granted person by person by an administrator (ADM). It is separate from your controller rating — a rating does not grant access here.
denied.how: Ask an ADM to grant you access; they do it from the roster in the instructor and management portal.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Which cycle is live, and where to go from here.
overview.jumpHint: Type a four-letter ICAO code and press Enter. Press / to come back here.
overview.jumpInvalid: An ICAO code is four letters, e.g. ZSPD.
overview.activeNote: Only these are counted; loading and superseded datasets are not.
overview.noActive: Every dataset is still loading or has been superseded. Activate one on the datasets page.

airports.title: 机场
airports.description: {count} 个机场，来自当前生效的周期。
airports.notFound: 没有这个机场的当前数据。
airports.magneticNote: 跑道与机位航向是**磁**航向，写进 FSD 位置包前要用上面的磁差换算成真航向。
airports.runwayNote: Geometry comes from the nav data, dimensions and surface from the AIP — a runway may have only one half. Headings are magnetic; a T marks an AIP true bearing.
airports.name: Name
airports.noRunways: No runway data for this airport

map.title: Map
map.description: 233 airports coloured by FIR; overlay the network's 569 sectors, the airway graph, and — once a FIR is picked — its fixes.
map.empty: No active dataset, so there is nothing to draw.
map.fixesNeedFir: Pick a FIR first — all 15,278 fixes at once reads as noise.
map.sectorDangling: This identifier resolves to no position in its own package — the row is kept because deleting it would leave a hole in the ranking
map.onlineHint: Online callsigns, comma separated: ZBAA_CTR, ZBAA_APP
map.uncovered: Uncovered — nobody on the chain is online
map.legendUnresolved: Faint package fill: not resolved yet — enter online callsigns first
map.legendOwned: Owner-coloured fill: covered (coloured by the owning position)
map.legendUncovered: Red dashed, no fill: uncovered — nobody on the chain is online

route.title: Route planner
route.description: Plans over the directed airway network and lists every published restriction the route runs into.
route.restrictionsNote: Published text, unedited — judging whether it applies is yours.
route.sourcePublishedNote: This is the compilation's own routing for the pair, given as published.
route.sourceComputedNote: The compilation publishes no routing for this pair, so this is a shortest path over the airway network — it knows nothing of military activity areas or agreed routings.
route.alternatives: {n} more published routing(s) for this pair
route.airspacesNote: Prohibited areas are already routed around; these are restricted and danger areas. The activity times are published text, unparsed — crossing one is not the same as being unable to fly it today.
route.notPublishable: No dataset here is redistributable — this route must not be published.
route.unknownCodes: {codes} is not in the current data — the request will fail.
route.idleHint: Once generated, the address bar links to this route, ready to share.
route.belowMtca: The requested cruise level is below it
route.scopeRouteNote: Attached by the compilation to this published routing — the most certain.
route.scopeSegmentNote: The published segment is one this route flies.
route.scopeAirwayNote: Only the airway matches; the published segment is elsewhere on it. The compilation uses both forms, so this is listed too.

airportMap.title: Airport map
airportMap.suspectCount: {n} procedure points sit over 400 km from the field — most likely a misresolved identifier
airportMap.groundNone: No ground features for this airport

fixes.title: 航路点
fixes.description: 按 FIR 浏览。**一个代号只在一个 FIR 内唯一** —— 全网有 267 个代号指向不止一个点，所以这里必须先选 FIR。
fixes.empty: 这个 FIR 没有航路点。
fixes.onMap: See this FIR on the map
fixes.truncated: {n} more not shown — narrow the search.
fixes.pickHint: One identifier can be different points in different FIRs, so pick a FIR above first.

datasets.title: 数据集
datasets.description: 每一次导入都是一个数据集：一个来源、一个 AIRAC 周期，带着它自己的许可状态。
datasets.cloneHint: The new dataset is created as a draft (loading) with source manual. It is not served until activated.
datasets.activateHint: Once active, this dataset is served to members with access.
datasets.supersedeHint: Once superseded, this dataset is no longer served. Its rows are kept.
datasets.deleteHint: Deleting removes every row and revision of this dataset. This cannot be undone.
datasets.deleteActiveReason: An active dataset cannot be deleted. Supersede it first.
datasets.thresholdHint: Minimum aipAccess level needed to see this dataset (0–4). Official AIP material cannot go below 3.
datasets.cloneAiracHint: Four-digit cycle; leave blank for can-db to use the next one.

notFound.title: This page is off the charts
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist, or it may have moved since you last flew here.

procedures.altNote: Altitude constraints are the published ARINC 424 encoding (e.g. 05910B03940A), left undecoded — decoding one wrong is worse than not decoding it. FO = flyover, MAP = missed approach point.
procedures.name: Name
procedures.empty: No procedure data for this airport

positions.title: ATC positions
positions.searchHint: Callsign, radio name, identifier or frequency
positions.networkDescription: {seats} positions the network actually staffs, under {callsigns} login callsigns. From the sector packages — tower, ground, delivery and ATIS are all here.
positions.alsoInHint: Also defined in this many other packages (for reconciliation — the home package is authoritative)

editor.deleteHint: This row is removed from the dataset, along with rows that reference it. Each removed row is written to the revision log.

editor.emptyTableHint: You can add the first row.
editor.prefilledHint: Parent columns are prefilled from the current filter.
editor.lockedHint: The parent column cannot change on edit. To move the row, delete it and add it under the new parent.

revisions.title: Revisions · {airac}
revisions.description: Every manual change to this dataset, newest first.

groundEditor.hintDraw: Click to add points · Enter or double-click to finish · Esc to cancel · Backspace removes the last point
groundEditor.noSelection: Nothing selected. Click a feature on the map or pick one from the list below.
groundEditor.name: Name
groundEditor.widthInvalid: Width must be a number greater than 0.
groundEditor.vertexMin: A {kind} needs at least {n} points; this vertex cannot be deleted.
